description:
The applicant seeks planning permission for a change of use from a C3 dwellinghouse to a C4 House in Multiple Occupation (HMO). No extensions or external alterations are proposed as part of this application.

At ground floor level, the scheme will provide communal facilities, including a games room, WC, shower room, storage area, lounge, and kitchen.

At first floor level, the proposal comprises three bedrooms, each benefitting from a private en‑suite shower room, along with two additional storage cupboards accessed from the circulation space.

At second floor level, the layout will include further communal facilities, comprising a kitchenette, lounge, shower room, and storage area.

The proposal also incorporates cycle parking provision, a dedicated refuse and recycling storage area, and a rear-facing patio area with steps providing access to the rear garden.
